v23-10.candidate: David said, “Lord, God of Israel, Thy servant has surely heard that Saul seeks to come against Keilah and destroy the city because of me.

v23-17.candidate: He said to him, “Do not fear. For my father Saul’s hand certainly will not find you. You will reign over Israel, and I will be second to you. My father Saul knows this.”

v24-20.candidate: For if someone finds his enemy in distress and sends him away on a good road, the Lord will repay him with good things, as you have done today.
